doc: Sheet is a spreadsheet like table, which renders only the cells of a window around the visible area. The client reports the area it needs through Viewport and receives the cells of that window.

1.doc: Id identifies the sheet within the view tree and must be unique.
1.name: Id

4.doc: FrozenRows are the leading rows, which stay visible while scrolling vertically.
4.name: FrozenRows

5.doc: FrozenCols are the leading columns, which stay visible while scrolling horizontally.
5.name: FrozenCols

6.doc: RowHeight is the height of every row in dp.
6.name: RowHeight

7.doc: ColWidth is the default width of a column in dp.
7.name: ColWidth

8.doc: ColWidths overrides the width of single columns.
8.name: ColWidths

9.doc: HiddenRows are the sorted indices of the hidden rows.
9.name: HiddenRows

10.doc: HiddenCols are the sorted indices of the hidden columns.
10.name: HiddenCols

11.doc: WindowRow is the first row of the window, whose cells are contained.
11.name: WindowRow

15.doc: Cells of the window and of the frozen rows and columns. Cells which are hidden or covered by a merge are omitted.
15.name: Cells

16.doc: Styles are referenced by the cells, so that equal styles are transferred once.
16.name: Styles

17.doc: Merges which intersect the window or the frozen rows and columns.
17.name: Merges

18.doc: Viewport is a state, into which the client writes the window it needs as row,col,rows,cols.
18.name: Viewport

19.doc: Edit is a state, into which the client writes a committed edit as json {seq,row,col,value}.
19.name: Edit

20.doc: EditSeq is the sequence number of the last edit, which has been processed.
20.name: EditSeq

21.doc: Copy is a state, into which the client writes a range as row,col,rows,cols, whose text the server copies into the clipboard.
21.name: Copy

26.doc: RowHeights overrides the height of single rows.
26.name: RowHeights

27.doc: Layout is a state, into which the client writes a change of the layout by the user as json, e.g. {"op":"resize","index":2,"size":120}, {"op":"hideCol","index":2}, {"op":"hideRow","index":5} or {"op":"showAll"}. It is zero, if the user may not change the layout.
27.name: Layout

28.doc: Paste is a state, into which the client writes pasted values as json {seq,edits:[{row,col,value}]}. It is zero, if pasting is not allowed.
28.name: Paste

29.doc: Header offers sorting and filtering in the last frozen row.
29.name: Header

30.doc: UserHidden are the hidden rows and columns, which the user has hidden and may show again.
30.name: UserHidden
